name: Asset Alchemist
title: Entertainment Overdrive — Convergence Foundation & Cinema Atmosphere Sync
subtitle: Entertainment Overdrive — Convergence Foundation & Cinema Atmosphere Sync
features: Launched a unified Entertainment Overdrive experience inside the existing Companion Center with five flagship paths; existing Cinema, Reactor IV, Arcade Chamber and Animation Forge remain accessible without adding another top-level studio
Introduced reusable Convergence scene presets with five built-in palettes, up to 20 custom scenes, and local save, restore, JSON import/export and Project Hub handoff
Added Cinema Overdrive Atmosphere Sync: user-controlled ambient glow around Video Vault and Media Theater players, sampled from supported local video frames with safe static-color fallback
Added Auto, Efficiency and Overdrive quality modes, reduced-motion awareness and throttled frame sampling for iPhone and PC
Preserved 18 active companion spaces, all retired-studio decisions, existing video bytes, bookmarks, Reactor settings, projects, Token Foundry and adaptive PC/iPhone interface

Maintained the existing GitHub Pages URL, release rollback cache, release validation and Discord notification pipeline; Sonic Dimension, Arcade Nexus, Infinite Realms and Creator Overdrive expanded implementations are explicitly staged in v3.5.1–v3.5.4
